The change: three commits that made a discrete-event simulation (SimPy and pandas) tens of times faster. The simulation used to build and filter a pandas DataFrame for every caller, every step of a journey and every result row. Those lookups are now built once, and the seeded output is byte-identical. The code is in [ReModel-Club/MOOOD-study](https://github.com/ReModel-Club/MOOOD-study/tree/add-codebase-tutorial), so the `file:line` references below point there.
